# Pee-Pa's Garage Hatchet Barn

> Pee-Pa's Garage Hatchet Barn is an axe throwing venue in Pinellas Park, Florida, serving Largo, St. Petersburg, and Seminole. Beginner-friendly lanes with expert coaches, WATL/WKTL sanctioned leagues, 20+ craft beers on tap, arcade gaming, and a food truck. Walk-ins welcome; book a lane online or call 727-526-6251. Minimum age to throw is 12 (a parent/guardian must sign for ages 12–17).

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/): Axe throwing in Pinellas Park — lanes, coaches, craft beer, arcade gaming, and the weekly Flingin' Friday $20 special.
- [WATL Leagues](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/watl-leagues/): WATL/WKTL sanctioned axe throwing leagues — 9-week seasons, all skill levels (Hatchet, Big Axe, Duals, Knives), pricing, and how to join.
- [Beer List](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/Beer-list/): Live tap list pulled from the brewery's Untappd account — what's pouring right now.
- [Upcoming Events](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/upcoming-events/): Flingin' Friday weekly special, the Big Axe Marathon, league seasons, and private events.
- [Group Events & Parties](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/group-events/): Book birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, corporate team-building, and holiday parties.
- [Contact](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/contact/): Location (6340 49th St. North #B, Pinellas Park, FL 33781), hours, phone, and message form.
- [Sign the Waiver](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/waiver/): Digital Release of Liability — required for all participants before throwing.
- [News & Updates](https://www.peepasgaragehatchetbarn.com/blog/): Stories and announcements from the Hatchet Barn.

- Sat: 1 PM – 11 PM
- Sun: 1 PM – 8 PM
